title: Seven Days in Almaty with Altyn Emel National Park
alt: Chalk cliffs of the Aktau mountains in Altyn Emel National Park
transport: Private airport transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Almaty
stops.accom: 6 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Long standing city hotel close to Republic Square

activities.name: Almaty city sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided tour of the old capital, taking in the Monument of Independence, Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral.

activities.name: Green Bazaar and the Rakhat chocolate factory
activities.match: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty
activities.description: The spice and dried fruit halls of the Green Bazaar, then the Rakhat factory whose chocolate every Kazakh family grew up on.

activities.name: Kok Tobe hill and the gondola
activities.match: Day Trip to Kok Tobe from Almaty
activities.description: The cable car up Kok Tobe for the whole city laid out below the mountains, with the Alley of Lovers at the top.

activities.name: Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake
activities.match: Day Trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake From Almaty
activities.description: A long day out to the red sandstone Valley of Castles in Charyn Canyon, then up to the forested shore of Kolsai lake.

activities.name: Lake Issyk day tour
activities.match: Issyk Lake Day Tour From Almaty
activities.description: A day east to the turquoise water of Lake Issyk, with the Saka burial mounds and the small site museum nearby.

activities.name: Altyn Emel National Park
activities.match: Trip to Altyn Emel National Park
activities.description: The Singing Dune that hums in the wind, the striped chalk ridges of the Aktau mountains and the Besshatyr burial mounds.

program.name: Almaty
program.description: Six nights in the old capital with five full days out: the city, Kok Tobe, Charyn Canyon, Lake Issyk and Altyn Emel.

day_titles.3: Green Bazaar, chocolate and Kok Tobe

1: Arrival at Almaty International and transfer to your hotel
Check in and the rest of the day free
Optional: the Palace of the Republic and Abai Square
Optional: the stalls of the Zelyony bazaar
2: Breakfast, then a guided tour of the city
The Monument of Independence on Republic Square
Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral
3: Breakfast, then into the Green Bazaar halls
Horse meat counters, dried fruit and spice stalls
The Rakhat chocolate factory and its shop
Up the Kok Tobe cable car for the city at dusk
4: Early breakfast and a long day out east
The red walls of the Valley of Castles
The canyon floor path beside the Charyn river
On to the forested shore of Kolsai lake
5: Breakfast, then east towards the Issyk gorge
The turquoise water of Lake Issyk
The Saka burial mounds and the site museum
6: Early breakfast and out onto the open steppe
The Singing Dune that hums in the wind
Striped chalk ridges of the Aktau mountains
The Besshatyr burial mounds before the long run back
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: Altyn Emel is the one almost nobody books, and it is the day everyone talks about afterwards. Coloured hills and a dune that sings.
expert.tip: Altyn Emel is a long day on rough tracks. If anyone in the group gets carsick, swap it for a second day at Kolsai and Kaindy.

summary: Seven days based in Almaty with five full days out: the city tour and Kok Tobe, the red walls of Charyn Canyon with Kolsai Lake, Lake Issyk, and the Singing Dune and chalk mountains of Altyn Emel National Park.
included: Included: 6 nights in Almaty with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; guided Almaty city sightseeing tour; Green Bazaar and Rakhat chocolate factory trip; Kok Tobe day trip; Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake day trip; Lake Issyk day tour; Altyn Emel National Park trip.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Kazakhstan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
